subject: prd/existing-repo-onboarding
statement: When apply completes, the system shall record an install-epoch baseline such that the documentation gates judge only content changed after it and grandfather the pre-existing corpus.
rationale: the epoch keeps a real corpus from failing every gate (D-5; installer's Q-4 grandfathering shape, prd:installer/Q-4)
fit_criterion: on the fixture (non-conforming corpus), the repo is gate-green immediately after adoption; a post-epoch change to a file is fully gated
